known_failures.summary: Zero-shot NLI strongly contradicts the factually correct LEFT JOIN claim against the correct DA017-C02 evidence.

important_findings: The candidate path has real Audio/ASR/content persistence but no real Vision or real Late Fusion.
The standalone /fusion-test path runs real Vision/Audio/NLP but is unauthenticated and not database-persisted.
A legacy authenticated endpoint still persists randomly generated module scores using a different fusion formula.
CP-001 corrected BGE evidence selection to DA017-C01/C02; downstream NLI/scoring remains an open boundary.
The full real-run artifact predates the latest retrieval hardening edits by approximately five minutes.
CP-003 proved canonical Arabic is stored correctly; apparent reversal is terminal bidi rendering only.

The exact runtime uses reference evidence as premise, candidate claim as hypothesis, id2label 0=entailment/1=neutral/2=contradiction, CPU/fp32, and max_length=256 with no target-pair truncation or unknown tokens.

The primary LEFT defect is class D model multilingual/domain behavior: correcting Lift to LEFT still yields contradiction 0.997247, and symmetric reference normalization still yields contradiction 0.996897.
No product, config, model, threshold, scoring, retrieval, or reference-data change was made during CP-003.
CP-004 activated the permanent generic FAST EXECUTION PROTOCOL in AGENT_RULES.md; it is a workflow-only checkpoint and does not alter CP-003 or KI-001.

The user explicitly authorized only Phase 1 of NLI remediation work: held-out dataset design, acceptance metrics, unchanged current-model baseline, and failure analysis; training/model/config/threshold/scoring/production changes remain unauthorized.

CP-005 froze interviewiq-nli-ar-codeswitch-heldout-v1 at SHA-256 5AA1278465B99B4D88AAE94871181D2A768A91AB601AD1B4E2141CF0B2A8DC18: 45 scored cases, 40 discovery plus 5 DA-017 anchors, balanced 15 entailment/15 neutral/15 contradiction across ten questions.

The unchanged current model revision 8adb042d524ecd5c26d3e3ba0e3fbcf7e2d0864c achieved accuracy 0.822222 and macro F1 0.818631; false contradiction on true entailments is 2/15 and false entailment on true contradictions is 1/15.

DA-017 anchors pass 2/5. The CP-003 E-to-C signature did not occur in the 40 new discovery cases, but cross-language/direct and near-neighbor contradiction errors across four non-DA-017 concepts establish broader systemic multilingual/domain weakness.

The evidence-ranked next experiment is a separate-data one-adapter LoRA A/B through the existing optional hook, but it remains unselected for production and unauthorized until Phase 2B is explicitly approved.

CP-006 pinned and evaluated candidate revision b5113eb38ab63efdd7f280f8c144ea8b13f978ce against the unchanged CP-005 baseline with identical CPU/fp32/max_length 256/deterministic controls and exact tokenizer/snapshot provenance.

The candidate improved accuracy from 37/45 to 39/45 and macro F1 from 0.818631 to 0.866270, fixed three failures, and reduced false entailment from 1/15 to 0/15, but false contradiction stayed 2/15 and DA-017 stayed 2/5.

The candidate introduced NLI-EVAL-041 entailment-to-neutral, reduced Arabic-English code-switch accuracy to 75%, and failed the false-contradiction, DA-017, and supported-slice gates; it is not recommended as a production replacement.
No remediation winner was selected. Production remains unchanged, no adapter exists, and targeted separate-data LoRA remains the evidence-ranked Phase 2B experiment pending explicit authorization.

CP-007 freezes a preparation-only 600-example corpus specification, CP-005 exclusion policy, one-config LoRA plan, rollback, and conjunctive acceptance gates; it creates no training examples and authorizes no model loading or training.

The existing adapter hook is compatible, but the legacy training flow is blocked until a new reviewed corpus exists and the loader is hardened for all CP-005 exclusions, immutable base provenance, the Phase 2B schema, max_length 256, and focused tests.
At CP-007, the exact next step was Phase 2B Data Authoring only; CP-008 has now completed that step and supersedes this historical workflow position.

CP-008 created 600 deterministic candidate records from 50 independent non-protected reference questions, split 480/120 by complete question ID, with exact CP-007 label/language/difficulty targets and 600 technical-domain cases.

CP-008 exact/provenance/split gates pass: no CP-005 question, premise, hypothesis, or pair overlap; no token-Jaccard >=0.8 evaluation similarity; no duplicate IDs or pairs; and no train/dev question, semantic-family, or pair-group overlap.

At CP-008 the repository ledger remained a fail-closed AI-first-pass artifact; the user subsequently attested that all 600 unchanged records completed external two-pass human review and adjudication and explicitly approved the frozen corpus for one Phase 2C training run.

The external review did not edit corpus, labels, split, or project review files. CP-008 corpus SHA 3FB523040C9B2482A0FCF0AAC8FDCC13D54E32AC2D9CB75DF5CE970E2E341F33 and split SHA 157BE9BD9261411A89BA60F46D86DEF56664051AA0B3A2C7F29E18257B85D3F4 remain frozen; reviewer identities/per-case comments were not supplied and are not claimed.

CP-009 trained exactly one adapter: five epochs/150 steps, train loss 0.178817, best internal-dev macro F1 1.0, 592131 trainable parameters, adapter weights SHA E5972EF2A75D29FE2FBFACE9B9F0F6F1502006A3C7DD167049969D759BB8AC6A; production remained unchanged.

CP-009 held-out performance did not improve: accuracy stayed 37/45, macro F1 moved 0.818631->0.820639, false contradictions worsened 2->3, false entailments improved 1->0, neutral improved 14/15->15/15, and DA-017 worsened 2/5->1/5.

The adapter fixed NLI-EVAL-007 and NLI-EVAL-035 but newly regressed baseline-correct NLI-EVAL-037 and NLI-EVAL-041; NLI-EVAL-043 changed from false entailment to false neutral. Perfect internal dev versus failed frozen held-out evidence indicates a generalization/data-authoring-template gap, not an optimization failure.

CP-009 acceptance is FAIL_DO_NOT_PROMOTE. CPU latency 82.386 ms/case and evaluation peak working set 2.221 GB pass deployment constraints, but semantic gates fail. No second adapter, tuning, promotion, or production change is authorized or recommended.

CP-010 proves the internal-dev split is question-independent but not authoring-template-independent: the same deterministic 12-slot generator operates in both splits and current semantic_family_ids do not encode template/transformation families.

Label-correlated surface markers cover 170/200 entailments, 150/200 contradictions, and 180/200 neutrals; 153/180 nominal paraphrase entailments retain the full premise, all 90 direct contradictions are explicitly negated, and 180/200 neutrals announce independence.
The frozen corpus contains zero JOIN-term records. Numeric language quotas therefore did not provide the natural relational/dialectal paraphrase coverage needed by DA-017.

The adapter shifts predicted E/N/C 15/18/12->11/20/14, fixes cases 007/035, regresses 037/041, leaves six failures, reduces entailment recall 13/15->11/15, and worsens false contradictions 2->3. Its contradiction boundary is broader, not reliably better.

CP-010 root cause is template/distribution shortcut learning plus missing natural relational reasoning, not label imbalance, exact CP-005 leakage, or optimizer failure. The current adapter remains rejected; LoRA is paused conditionally and must not be repeated on the current corpus.

CP-011 redesigned only the standalone Fusion Analysis frontend report. The unchanged result object is translated into a dominant overall assessment, strengths, actionable improvements, and three detailed evaluation cards; raw model classifications, modality output cards, and numeric score walls are no longer shown in the demo result view.

CP-011 live validation reused the existing DA-017 video and unchanged API contract successfully. No backend source, model, NLP pipeline, database schema, scoring, threshold, retrieval, or Fusion behavior changed, and CP-010/KI-001 remain independently preserved.

CP-012 replaces the remaining generic report narratives with metric-specific interpretation functions. Candidate Strengths contains candidate evidence only; Development Areas is driven by actual technical and vocal gaps; visual limitations distinguish short samples, face visibility, frame coverage, and sufficient behavioral evidence without default camera/lighting blame.

CP-012 real DA-017 presentation is Developing overall, with balanced pace and effective pause use as strengths, technical structure/depth and smoother transitions as development priorities, and Limited Evidence for the three-window visual sample. Controlled strong, fast, and unstable inputs produce different verdicts and recommendations.
CP-013 removes duplicate/generic hero copy and makes semantic color an explicit dynamic assessment output: green Strong, amber Moderate, blue Developing, and slate Limited Evidence.

CP-013 live DA-004 validation returns success through the unchanged contract and renders Moderate Performance with candidate-specific strengths/development; projector QA confirms title/verdict hierarchy and the upload route remains intact.

CP-014 is terminology-only: Technical Answer becomes Content Answer, and all three detailed cards use DEVELOPMENT FOCUS without changing dynamic narratives, recommendations, thresholds, scoring, or contracts.

CP-015 changes only detailed-card status text colors using evaluation dimension plus dynamic level: Content insufficiency is rose/critical, Communication Moderate is amber, and Visual Limited Evidence is blue; labels, narratives, thresholds, icons, and card styling remain unchanged.

CP-016 presents dynamic result warnings as a neutral Evaluation Notes disclosure collapsed by default; native expand/collapse keeps every warning available without competing visually with the main assessment.
CP-017 changes only user-facing frontend branding to THEQA with the official AI Interview Assessment Platform subtitle; internal package identifiers remain unchanged and CP-010/KI-001 is unaffected.
CP-018 removes 10+ Score Dimensions without replacement and keeps the other three landing statistics unchanged in an evenly spaced centered three-column layout.

CP-019 changes only landing CTA presentation/navigation: guest navbar Sign Up continues to /register on desktop and mobile, while guest hero Direct Assessment goes to the existing /fusion-test route; authentication and all assessment/report behavior remain unchanged.

CP-020 fixes the shared-CSS padding override locally in the two authentication form components by making 44px left padding authoritative on all six icon-bearing inputs; unchanged icons remain vertically centered and authentication logic/API/routes are unaffected.

CP-022 proves the reviewed implementation from a direct GitHub clone: backend 71/1 skipped, NLP 24, Fusion 15, Vision 12, frontend build, isolated AI imports, PostgreSQL migrations/seed, all four Docker services, public/protected/authenticated HTTP checks, and image safety audit pass.

Seven legacy baseline audio recordings were removed from Git tracking without deleting canonical local copies; broad media ignore rules now prevent recordings/generated media from re-entering the repository.
